Scenario fixture: link-name-present

Targets: a[href], area[href], [role="link"]. Name sources: aria-label / aria-labelledby / label[for] / title (via getAccessibleNameInfo), then conservative subtree-text content fallback for ALL matched elements (unlike the "author-only-name" widget roles). Each target has a stable id link_case_NN.

A. Baseline: mechanism priority order (eligible)

01 — FAIL: empty <a href>, no text, no aria
02 — PASS: <a href> with text content
Read more
03 — PASS: <a href> aria-label overrides content
🔍
04 — PASS: <a href> aria-labelledby
Download report ⬇️
05 — PASS: <a href> title
06 — PASS: <a href> visible text + aria-hidden icon (icon ignored)
🛒 View cart
08b — FAIL: <a href> whose only content is aria-hidden text
Hidden text
Content hidden from AT must not count as the link's accessible name.
09 — FAIL: <a href> whitespace-only content
10 — FAIL: <a href> aria-label empty string, empty content
11 — FAIL: role=link (span), focusable, no name, no content
12 — PASS: role=link (span), content (content fallback allowed)
Open settings
13 — PASS: <area href> with alt only (alt is a recognized accessible-name mechanism for area, per accname/ACT c487ae)
14 — PASS: <area href> with aria-label

B. Eligibility exceptions that hold either way

FIXED: link-name-present.js previously treated helpers.isAccTreeEligible(el, ctx)'s return value (an object, always truthy) directly as a boolean, so the eligibility filter never actually excluded anything. It now correctly reads .eligible, so the ineligibility cases below (previously excluded from this fixture) are exercised here.

15b — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: aria-hidden="true", no focus exception, missing name
Explicit tabindex<0 (programmatic focus only) does not override aria-hidden.
15c — NEUTRAL: native <a href>, aria-hidden="true" => out of scope here; aria-hidden-focus reports this markup
<a href> is natively tabbable by default, but ACT c487ae excludes focusable aria-hidden content from this rule, so it stays out of scope here (see the eligibility comment in the rule source).
15d — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: hidden attribute, missing name
15e — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: display:none, missing name
15f — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: visibility:hidden, no visible-descendant override, missing name
15g — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inert, missing name
15h — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inert ancestor, missing name
16 — EXCEPTION: aria-hidden="true" but focusable (explicit tabindex=0) => excluded from naming rules (ACT: not included in the accessibility tree); aria-hidden-focus reports it
20 — EXCEPTION: visibility:hidden ancestor overridden by descendant visibility:visible => eligible, missing name => FAIL

C. Name from content — recursive

21 — PASS: logo link, name comes from a wrapped <img alt> (name-from-content recursion, not just literal text nodes)
22 — PASS: name comes from a nested role="img" element's aria-label (name-from-content recursion)
23 — PASS: name comes from a nested <img alt="" aria-labelledby> — empty alt correctly marks the image itself decorative, but aria-labelledby (pointing to real text elsewhere) takes priority over alt per the accname spec
Sony Wireless Headphones

D. role override to a value-role (content is a VALUE, not a NAME)

24 — FAIL: <a href role="combobox">, no programmatic name — content ("List") is the combobox's selected VALUE, not its name, so it must not be credited
List
25 — PASS: <a href role="combobox"> with aria-label — programmatic name still works normally for a value-role override
List

End of fixture.
